title: Resolution urging Albany to require full insurance coverage for lactation care
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass legislation requiring insurers to cover all lactation consultation and counseling services without restrictions and to reimburse providers accordingly. It cites reports that insurers have limited billing for lactation care and that reimbursement rates have stagnated, making it harder for parents to access support and for providers to sustain their practices. It notes a 2025 study finding New York had 1,057 IBCLCs statewide, below the national average per capita.
